column1: # Dated field reports from Foxwell Founders members and Foxwell posts. Qualitative unless a figure is stated.

column3: Meta added an "Other" Health & Wellness subcategory in mid-2025, catching tangentially related advertisers; across 300+ flagged accounts: higher CPA and CPM, lower CVR; appeals succeed 15-25% of the time.
One brand's one-hour gift-with-purchase drops lifted hourly revenue from ~$50K to $142K and $172K at ~9x MER; 40%+ of Meta spend went to BFCM-specific creative.
Meta ads management without creative: 3-10% of ad spend a month, falling as spend rises; with creative, CRO, Google and other services up to 15-20% (Founders survey of 200+ agencies).
Members flagged disruption from about 17 Sep: CPMs down roughly 30% across accounts in several countries, but CTR and purchases fell too (lower-quality audiences).
